checks.proves: Runs payout, settlement, reconciliation, ledger and operator-context tests including new manual-settlement controls.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not prove real finance staff procedure or official-wallet statement format.
checks.passCriteria: All destination, hold, batch, evidence, reconciliation and close invariants pass.
checks.failCriteria: Any unverified payout, batch mutation, duplicate reference, self-approval bypass or unreconciled completion fails.

checks.proves: Inventories legacy destination semantics and proves active target paths use official-wallet destination/version/verification.
checks.doesNotProve: Search cannot prove encrypted persisted values or migration correctness.
checks.passCriteria: Legacy bank/manual fields are compatibility/history only and no active payout path treats manual as destination type.
checks.failCriteria: Active bank/IBAN/provider-payout semantics remain reachable without explicit separately approved capability.

checks.command: pnpm run guard:migration-manifest-drift && pnpm run runtime:wlt:migrate
checks.proves: Exercises forward migrations, uniqueness and immutable batch/evidence constraints.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not prove production statement imports or large-volume performance.
checks.passCriteria: Fresh/non-empty migration scenarios pass and historical payout/settlement rows are preserved.
checks.failCriteria: Data loss, history rewrite, mutable frozen rows or duplicate external-reference allowance fails.

checks.command: MANUAL: execute settlement scenarios for approved batch, duplicate reference, missing evidence, statement mismatch, executor/checker conflict, unknown external result, restart and daily-close blocking
checks.proves: Proves the manual external settlement state machine and finance-close gates under realistic success/failure paths.
checks.doesNotProve: Requires a configured runtime and representative non-production statement/evidence fixtures; it does not prove a real provider contract.
checks.passCriteria: Only fully reconciled rows complete, every failure is recoverable/audited, and close is blocked until material exposure resolves.
checks.failCriteria: Bare completion, lost hold/evidence, role bypass or close-with-exposure fails.

checks.command: MANUAL: test finance object authorization, operator-context isolation, destination masking/reveal, export access, replay, IDOR and SoD
checks.proves: Proves sensitive payout/settlement operations are server-protected and auditable.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not substitute for independent penetration testing.
checks.passCriteria: Cross-context/cross-role access is denied, raw identifiers are least-privilege, and all sensitive actions emit audit evidence.
checks.failCriteria: Any IDOR, secret/PII leakage, UI-only authorization or silent SoD bypass fails.
